en.hubeali: Al Sayyari, from the one who reported it,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who is keen to reduce his anger, so let him eat the meat of the pheasant’.
en.sarwar: 3. Al-Sayyariy has narrated from those who narrated to him who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
If reducing one’s anger makes him happy he should eat partridge meat.’”
